title: Send a link about the election
blurb: Links to posts, articles or video about something that happened at an election. Not your own account of what you saw, and no uploads.

fields.label: Link
fields.help: A post, article or video about something that happened. Up to three.

fields.label: Where
fields.help: The state, and the county if you know it. Leave it blank if you are not sure.

fields.label: What day was it?
fields.help: Leave it blank if you are not sure.

fields.label: What kind of thing is it

options: Voter turned away or denied a ballot

fields.label: Anything we should know about the link
fields.help: Optional. Context about the link, not an account of what you saw.
